title: Research: extend conditional P112 mixed566 common cut to 34
body:
## Summary

Extend the conditional P112 shortening theorem for three arbitrary residual binary-support ranks 5,6,6 over every characteristic-zero field.

```diff
- one common cut of at most 33 coordinates
+ one common cut of at most 34 coordinates
```

The new equality step concentrates the rank-five piece in the D6 union 82 case after the rank-six capacities tighten to 18 each. The full proof also handles the newly permitted union 86 case. No sharpness, caller exclusion, full C5, supplier, kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Evidence

- Before: PR3325 explicitly leaves cut 34 open; its original union 82 singleton bound does not force rank-five concentration. After: a 48-site cover saturates 12+18+18, forcing 12 singleton sites and two-axis coverage at most 47. The recorded stronger bound 46 uses the inherited pair-union 28 lemma. Other D6 branches give 48<50/51/52; E6 gives 86<88.
- `research/p112-mixed566-cut34/` includes the proof, exact results, source pins, replay hook, separate reconstruction and six optimized behavior/source controls. The new checks cover 3,780 orthogonal root pairs, 896 ordered union 82 axes, 26-zero parabolic counts and 4,693 refined support-size triples.
- Python 3.12.15 registered replay, optimized Python 3.15 checks, warning-as-error compilation and Ruff 0.14 pass. All 15 committed package/input byte comparisons and source-history checks pass. All three final publication scripts pass on an actual regular-only, read-only Git-free export under Python 3.14. All 10 scientific files are unchanged from scientific commit `d980a3f2bf90c67dc0dad0a8fa659a18f77b3586`; publication is `9677b4bcdc77f1e22a2891b6ff1b150c7f008395`.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-mixed566-cut34
```

The inherited capacity, concentration, E6 incidence, pair-union, four-puncture and Weyl premises remain conditional. Their historical heavy suites, selected cold replay, Lean, Docker and human/proof-kernel review are unrun. Exact limits and Open next questions are in the package.

Canonical baseline `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6, was refetched unchanged. Submission overlap covers 265 open PRs and 2,193 Discussion records with complete pagination, excluding arbitrary diffs and unpublished work. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19007739).

Credit PR3325/3299/3295/3324/3292 and the retained PR3278/3267/3260/3262/3269, DreamingOfClouds/PR3154, David Arias, joaqcoo and E8/P112/root-simplex lineage.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

One new research package. Frozen predecessors, shared checkers and selected science are unchanged. Merging this package would not independently validate its inherited premises or admit a supplier.
